caption:
Everyone Googled "how to set up custom instructions" and called it a day.

Here's what actually happens:

You type something like "be concise and professional" into the box.

And the AI just... slightly adjusts its tone. Cool. Revolutionary.

The problem isn't the setup. It's that you're describing a vibe, not a brain.

"Be concise" doesn't tell ChatGPT that you hate bullet points when you're brainstorming but love them when you're reviewing.

"Be professional" doesn't tell Claude that your version of professional still has a little edge to it.

"Focus on business" doesn't tell Gemini that you think in systems, not in steps.

Custom instructions are a text box. Your thinking style is an operating system.

That's the gap BootFile closes.

Instead of you guessing what to write in that box, we figure out how you actually think — your reasoning style, your communication preferences, your blind spots — and turn that into an instruction profile that works across every AI tool you use.

Same brain. Every model.

No more re-explaining yourself. No more "that's not what I meant." No more AI responses that are technically correct but feel completely off.

Link in bio to build yours.
hook: Everyone set up custom instructions wrong (including you, probably).
